description: Fermeture du réseau cuivre is a dataset listed in Open Data du Ministère de l'Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté industrielle, énergétique et numérique, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a national body, published or maintained by DGE. Ce jeu de données issu du fichier trajectoire d'Orange sur la fermeture du réseau cuivre alimente le module de recherche à la commune du site d'information de l'Etat: La fermeture du réseau cuivre dans votre commune economie.gouv.fr. Coverage: France. Its keywords are télécoms, fermeture_du_cuivre. The portal shows 35,305 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-10-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-economie-gouv-fr-portal.
